quote: Sirius will notify the customer of confirmed security incidents in due course, taking into account the nature and circumstances of the incident.
policy_quote: Vendor must notify us within 72 hours of detecting a breach affecting our data. Violation: notice window >72 hours, or no specific window stated.
reason: 'In due course' states no hour window. The policy lists 'no specific window stated' as a violation.
suggested_fix: Replace 'in due course' with notice within 72 hours of detecting a breach that affects our data.
